hebrewText: בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָ/י֮ י֤וֹם י֥וֹם יַֽעֲמָס לָ֗/נוּ הָ֘/אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬/נוּ סֶֽלָה

tokens.bdb: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)

tokens.bdb: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
tokens.kjv: God (god), [idiom] goodly, [idiom] great, idol, might(-y one), power, strong. Compare names in '-el.'
